name: Dependent Family Members of a Resident

requirements.blocker_text: Law No. 23/2022 allows a sponsor's signed responsibility declaration (proving financial capacity) to substitute for a dependent's own proof of means of subsistence, and provisional refugee residence permits explicitly extend to family members. This dataset could NOT locate a separate, dedicated family-reunification visa category with its own numeric income/wait-time thresholds distinct from the general residence-authorization framework (see mz_long_term_residence.json) -- unlike some other countries built in this dataset, Mozambique's foreign-citizens law does not appear to spell out a standalone family-reunification track in the text this build could access.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain a sponsor's responsibility declaration from the Mozambique-resident family member, or apply as a dependent alongside their residence/refugee application.

evidence_required.document: Proof of family relationship (marriage or birth certificate)

outcome.duration_length: tied to the sponsor's own residence status

sources.title: UNHCR Rights Mapping and Analysis Platform -- Law no. 23/2022: sponsor's responsibility declaration mechanism, family inclusion in provisional refugee permits

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Mozambique). STATUS: DRAFT -- tier 2, but this route rests on a thinner finding than most of this dataset's family_reunification files: no dedicated numeric family-reunification category (income threshold, minimum marriage duration, wait time) could be confirmed for Mozambique specifically -- this dataset found only the general sponsor-declaration mechanism and refugee-specific family inclusion. This is a genuine, disclosed gap in what this build could confirm, not a claim that no such dedicated track exists at all.
